hypotheses.R0_numerical_controls_reconstruct: The full native and rotated coordinate sets reproduce the complete final-position MLP patch with at least 0.95 median Fisher fidelity in every cell, and inverse rotation has relative error at most 1e-5.
hypotheses.R1_dynamic_native_execution_is_moderatel: Target-conditioned native coordinates reach 0.50 median fidelity by rank 256 in every layer/corpus cell.
hypotheses.R2_native_basis_is_privileged: At rank 256 native local selection beats rotated local selection by at least 0.05 and has pair-bootstrap 95% interval above zero in every cell.
hypotheses.R3_high_fidelity_native_execution_is_bro: Target-conditioned native selection requires at least 1024 channels to reach 0.90 median fidelity in every cell.
hypotheses.R4_fixed_semantic_banks_are_not_sufficie: The correct rank-256 family bank has median fidelity below 0.35 and trails the target-conditioned native rank-256 selector by at least 0.25 in every cell.
hypotheses.R5_fixed_semantic_identity_is_detectable: Correct-family banks beat the within-example median wrong-family bank by at least 0.03 and have pair-bootstrap 95% interval above zero in every cell.
hypotheses.R6_dynamic_alignment_transfers_ood: The rank-256 native-minus-rotated advantage differs by at most 0.10 between FineWeb and TinyStories at each layer.
hypotheses.R7_qualitative_ontology_replicates: The independent checkpoint simultaneously passes moderate dynamic sparsity, native-basis privilege, broad high-fidelity support, and fixed-bank insufficiency.
hypotheses.R8_activation_ranking_is_state_informati: At rank 256 activation-magnitude selection reaches at least 0.50 fidelity and lies within 0.15 of target-conditioned native selection in every cell.
